headline: Local Samosa Shopkeeper Appointed As India's Chief Trade Negotiator After Successfully Selling Two Pastries To An American Tourist
body:
Following the recent waiving of tariffs that threatened the local snack industry, the Ministry of External Affairs has officially appointed Ramesh Gupta, a local stall owner, as India’s lead trade negotiator. The appointment comes after Gupta successfully maneuvered a complex international transaction involving two aloo samosas, a cup of cutting chai, and an American tourist who mistakenly believed the chutney was a dipping sauce for a handheld sandwich.

"Ramesh has demonstrated an uncanny ability to balance high-stakes geopolitical tension with the immediate pressure of an impatient lunch crowd," said a ministry spokesperson. "When the tourist tried to negotiate for an extra spicy packet without paying the additional two rupees, Ramesh maintained his composure, held the price line, and successfully upsold a secondary pack of salted peanuts. That level of diplomatic resilience is exactly what we need for global trade summits."

Gupta, who has been operating his corner kiosk for over two decades, is already preparing for his first G20 trade session. He plans to utilize his proprietary 'Three-Puff Technique'—a strategy involving tactical nodding, a feigned search for change, and the strategic deployment of a complimentary mirchi—to ensure that any future tariff threats are neutralized before the customer even reaches the counter.

"It’s not much different from dealing with a regular supplier who tries to inflate the price of onions," Gupta remarked while packing a fresh batch of snacks. "You just have to look them in the eye, ask about their health, and remind them that the market rate is non-negotiable unless they want to stand in the sun for an hour. If it works for a corporate office worker in a hurry, it will work for a superpower."
caption: From serving samosas to saving the national economy, Ramesh is ready for the world stage. Who says you need a degree in economics when you have a perfectly brewed cup of chai? #IndiaTrade #Diplomacy #SamosaDiplomacy #GlobalMarkets (satire)
